senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צמר to be pressed, thick, warm; cmp. עמר) wool, hair.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:2">Kil. VII, 2</cite> <he>צ׳ גפן</he>, v. <cite ref="C01204"><he>גֶּפֶן</he></cite>. Y. ib. II, 27ᵈ <he>גפן הצ׳</he> cotton tree.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:3">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:3">X</cite>), 3 <he>צ׳ ארנבים</he> (not <he>ביים …</he>) hair of hares.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="R00596"><he>צמרי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 10:18">Gen. X, 18</cite>) (the inhabitants of Ḥamatz are named Zemarites,) <he>שהן עושין בצ׳</he> because they work in wool.
<cite ref="Yevamot 4b:14">Yeb. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ לפשתים ופשתים לצ׳</he> woolen show-fringes for linen garments, and linen for woolen garments; a. fr.
